name: ohara-where-to-watch
description: Find where a specific movie or TV show is currently available to stream, watch free, rent, or buy in the United States, United Kingdom, or Canada. The plugin returns current provider availability and direct provider links when available. Streaming availability data is provided by Watchmode. It does not recommend titles, play or download content, access streaming accounts, or facilitate piracy. Availability can change, so confirm critical details with the streaming provider.

interface.longDescription: Find where a specific movie or TV show is currently available to stream, watch free, rent, or buy in the United States, United Kingdom, or Canada. defaultPrompt: Where can I watch this movie?
Where can I rent or buy this title?

positive.description: Find a movie's current US availability
positive.prompt: Where can I watch The Dark Knight (2008 movie) in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matched movie and current US streaming, free, rental, or purchase options when available.

positive.description: Find a newer movie's streaming availability
positive.prompt: Is Dune: Part Two streaming anywhere in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matched movie and current US viewing options, grouped or labeled by access type.

positive.prompt: Where can I rent or buy Oppenheimer in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Return current US rental and purchase providers when available, while also preserving any other lawful availability returned by the provider.

positive.description: Find a specific TV series by year
positive.prompt: Where is The Office, the US TV series from 2005, available to stream in the United States?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the 2005 US TV series and return current US streaming availability rather than a different title named The Office.

positive.prompt: Where can I watch Spirited Away in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matched movie and current US viewing options when available.

negative.description: Recommendation request is out of scope
negative.prompt: Recommend a funny movie for tonight.

negative.description: Plot summary is out of scope
negative.prompt: Summarize the plot of The Dark Knight.

negative.description: Pirated download request is out of scope
negative.prompt: Give me a free pirated download of Oppenheimer.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell content, subscriptions, products, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial free-tier pilot with current movie and TV streaming, free viewing, rental, and purchase availability for the US, UK, and Canada, Watchmode attribution, and explicit title disambiguation when needed.
